name: Hesperian-Yardang
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Approach protocols for the quarantine zone are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
